name: flowers that bloom only once
source: Corinna, a communist partisan, is captured by the Fascists and reunited with her childhood friend, Orsolina, who had joined the Fascist army as a member of the Women's auxiliary.  As they try to  settle their differences, both women ruminate on their childhood and what led them to where they are.
